proof_availability.classification_scope: The producer reports an acquired raw pipeline for Y in Hom_R(R^b,U), U=sum_i R/(t^li), faithful mixed inner U and rectangular right matrices. A paired equalizer recovers chain-ring actions and actual transports, then checks equality with the whole Hom space. Positive adjacent-type image weights yield deterministic polynomial counts, separate witness search and expected-polynomial exact uniform samples of complete original assignments.
unavailable_or_unclassified: The ordinary-circuit recognizer remains partial; two 60-input encodings declined and are not empty fibers or larger successes. Actual coordinates, original affine reconstruction and gate checks remain required. Nonfree output modules need nested actual K_j=phi(U[t^j]); a compressed global sum over those filtered images is open. Earlier nonfaithful-obstruction wording was corrected in version2, whose full original details were not acquired. No demonstrated timing advantage.
